top_story.headline: A quiet day: no new ethics, foreign-agent or financial-disclosure filings stand out
top_story.dek: The only new items are routine lobbying registrations.
paragraphs: The Office of Government Ethics database showed no new divestiture, termination or ethics-agreement filings for October 4–6. The Department of Justice's FARA e-file system listed zero new and zero terminated registrants for October 6–7. Every House and Senate disclosure filed since October 4 had already been reported in earlier editions.
The Senate lobbying database posted 44 new registrations, none tied to a member or bill mentioned elsewhere in today's edition.

sections.headline: No new ethics filings to report
paragraphs: No new certificate of divestiture, termination of agreement, or ethics agreement filings were flagged in the Office of Government Ethics database for October 4–6, 2026.

sections.headline: 44 new lobbying registrations, led by health care, defense and technology clients
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying database shows 44 new registrations posted since October 6, 2026. Most are routine; THE VOGEL GROUP's registration for EVERPURE, INC. is that client's first-ever lobbying registration (see Industries to Watch). Each client name links to its filing. Quarterly activity reports and terminations were also posted but are not itemized here.
